ability.steelstorm.battleaxe_berserker_r: Fly into a rage for 8 seconds: swing 60% faster, hit 4 harder, heal from every blow, ignore Stagger, and every hit bursts into a wave of blood.
Hurl a hooked chain at the enemy you look at (up to 16 blocks) and drag it to your feet, staggered and with its armour broken.
ability.steelstorm.battleaxe_war_cry.des: A terrifying roar. Enemies within 8 blocks are weakened, slowed and staggered; you gain Strength and Speed for 6 seconds.
ability.steelstorm.battleaxe_whirlwind.d: Spin like a whirlwind for over a second, hitting everything around you six times. You can keep moving.
Every Bleed on every enemy within 10 blocks bursts at once. Each stack deals heavy damage and heals you.
ability.steelstorm.chakram_blade_tempest: Eight chakrams orbit you in a wide, deadly ring for 7 seconds, shredding everything they touch and blocking projectiles.
ability.steelstorm.chakram_guard_ring.de: Four spectral chakrams circle you for 5 seconds, cutting anything close and knocking arrows out of the air.
ability.steelstorm.chakram_sawblade.desc: Throw a spectral chakram that stops where it lands and grinds everything around it for 3 seconds before flying back.
ability.steelstorm.chakram_twin_throw.de: Throw two spectral chakrams at once, angled apart. Each one bounces between enemies.
ability.steelstorm.dual_daggers_death_bl: Melt into the shadows for 5 seconds: you turn invisible and fast, enemies lose track of you, and your next four hits deal triple damage.
ability.steelstorm.dual_daggers_fan_of_k: Spin and fling a ring of twelve spectral knives in every direction.
ability.steelstorm.dual_daggers_flurry.d: Five lightning-quick stabs at the enemy in front of you. The last one opens a bleeding wound.
ability.steelstorm.dual_daggers_shadowst: Step through the shadows to appear behind the enemy you're looking at (up to 12 blocks). Your next hit within 3 seconds is a backstab for 2.5x damage.
ability.steelstorm.earthshaker_tectonic_: Strike the ground and it splits open in eight fissures that spiral out one after another, throwing everything they touch into the air.
ability.steelstorm.greatsword_colossus_s: Raise the greatsword for a moment, then slam it down: a 16-block fissure tears open ahead of you and a shockwave bursts out around you.
ability.steelstorm.greatsword_crescent_w: Swing a wave of force that flies 16 blocks, passing through every enemy in its way.
ability.steelstorm.greatsword_sword_sanc: Hurl a giant spectral greatsword into the ground ahead. For 5 seconds it draws enemies in, slows them and burns them every second, then it explodes.
ability.steelstorm.greatsword_titans_gua: Plant your feet and raise the greatsword like a wall for 3 seconds: you take a quarter of the damage, and everything you soak up is hurled back in a blast in front of you when the guard drops.
ability.steelstorm.katana_flash_step.des: Vanish and reappear 7 blocks ahead. Everything you passed is cut a heartbeat later and starts to bleed.
ability.steelstorm.katana_iaido.desc: Sheathe the blade, then draw it in one wide, lightning-fast cut that deals heavy damage and two stacks of Bleed.
Blink between up to eight nearby enemies, cutting each one, then return to where you started as every wound opens at once. You can't be hurt while it lasts.
ability.steelstorm.katana_wind_scar.desc: Three cuts so fast the air splits: two crossing blades of wind and a third straight down the middle, all meeting where you aim.
ability.steelstorm.kingsbane_regicide.de: Leap onto the enemy you look at and bring the axe down for 4x damage, or 8x if it is below 30% health. A kill refunds half of your ultimate.
Dash 6 blocks forward, cutting and staggering every enemy you pass through.
ability.steelstorm.longsword_judgment.de: Six giant spectral swords rain down around the spot you look at, then a seventh crashes into the centre with a shockwave.
ability.steelstorm.longsword_riposte.des: Take a parrying stance for 1.5 seconds. The next attack against you is turned aside and answered with a counter-strike for double damage that staggers the attacker.
Hurl a glowing copy of your sword where you look. Holds 3 charges: throw them one after another.
ability.steelstorm.moonveil_moonfall.des: Moonlight pins every enemy within 12 blocks in place, then three great crescents of moonlight sweep out in front of you.
ability.steelstorm.rimecleaver_absolute_: Freeze every enemy within 9 blocks solid in a shell of ice. Two seconds later the ice shatters for heavy damage.
ability.steelstorm.scythe_death_mark.des: Doom every enemy within 12 blocks. In 3 seconds the doom falls: each one takes heavy damage, plus half of all the damage dealt to it while it was marked.
ability.steelstorm.scythe_deaths_crescen: Throw a spinning crescent of death that flies out 12 blocks and comes back, cutting everything both ways.
ability.steelstorm.scythe_reap.desc: A full circle sweep that cuts everything around you and drains 15% of the damage as health.
ability.steelstorm.scythe_soul_harvest.d: Rip at the souls of every enemy within 9 blocks, dragging them toward you and Marking them for 6 seconds. Marked enemies glow, take 15% more damage and heal you when you hit them.
ability.steelstorm.skypiercer_updraft.de: Spin up a roaring tornado where you aim. For 4 seconds it sucks enemies in and hurls them skyward, where Skypiercer hits them twice as hard.
ability.steelstorm.spear_dragon_dive.des: Leap high into the air and dive like a dragon onto the spot you look at (up to 20 blocks away), blasting a crater and splitting the ground in four directions.
ability.steelstorm.spear_impale.desc: Lunge forward and drive the spear through everything in a 7-block line, pinning them in place.
ability.steelstorm.spear_sweeping_arc.de: A huge sweep that covers almost everything in front of and beside you, throwing enemies back hard.
ability.steelstorm.spear_vault_leap.desc: Pole-vault high and far forward. You land with a shockwave that knocks nearby enemies up.
ability.steelstorm.tempest_edge_thunder_: Call down eight bolts of lightning, one after another, on the enemies around you.
Throw a knife of shadow. Wherever it lands, you appear; if it hits an enemy, you appear behind them.
ability.steelstorm.throwing_knife_knife_: Forty spectral knives rain down on the spot you look at over a second and a half.
Coat your knives in venom: your next 8 throws poison and bleed whatever they hit.
ability.steelstorm.throwing_knife_volley: Throw a fan of five spectral knives at once.
ability.steelstorm.voidreaver_event_hori: Tear open a black hole 10 blocks ahead. For 5 seconds it swallows everything nearby, then collapses in a devastating blast.
ability.steelstorm.warhammer_cataclysm.d: Leap high into the air and come down like a meteor: three huge shockwaves roll out 12 blocks, launching and staggering everything they reach.
Smash the ground so hard it ripples outward in a 7-block shockwave that launches every enemy it reaches, followed by a wider aftershock.
ability.steelstorm.warhammer_hammer_thro: Hurl your hammer up to 14 blocks. It smashes into the first enemy or wall with a shockwave, staggering and breaking armour, then flies back to your hand.
ability.steelstorm.warhammer_stone_priso: Slam the ground and seal the enemy you look at (up to 14 blocks) in a shell of rock. It can't move for 3 seconds, then the prison shatters for heavy damage.
enchantment.steelstorm.executioner.desc: Deal extra damage to enemies below 35% health.
enchantment.steelstorm.lacerate.desc: Hits have a chance to cause Bleed.

tooltip.steelstorm.armor.boots.desc: Jump again in mid-air; hard landings send out a shockwave
tooltip.steelstorm.armor.chestplate.desc: Every 20 s, absorbs a hit and blasts attackers away
tooltip.steelstorm.armor.helmet.desc: Hostile mobs within 24 blocks glow through walls
tooltip.steelstorm.armor.leggings.desc: Sprint for 1.5 s to surge to Speed II

tooltip.steelstorm.stormsteel: Stormsteel: hits sometimes zap a second nearby enemy
tooltip.steelstorm.stormsteel_set.desc: 10% faster, immune to lightning, melee attackers may be zapped
tooltip.steelstorm.target_dummy: Shows the damage of every hit. Sneak-punch with an empty hand to pick it up.
tooltip.steelstorm.throwing_knife: Right-click to throw. 30% chance to cause Bleed.
tooltip.steelstorm.vault_key: Opens a Bandit Vault. Carried by Bandit Captains.

weapon.steelstorm.bloodfang.legendary: Hits cause Bleed; striking a bleeding enemy heals you
weapon.steelstorm.dual_daggers.passive: Double damage when striking from behind
weapon.steelstorm.earthshaker.legendary: Combo finishers send a shockwave through the ground
weapon.steelstorm.greatsword.passive: Wide sweeping strikes hit enemies around your target
weapon.steelstorm.kingsbane.legendary: +50% damage against enemies with more health than you
weapon.steelstorm.longsword.passive: Every 3rd hit in a row deals +30% damage
weapon.steelstorm.moonveil.legendary: Critical hits release a crescent of moonlight
weapon.steelstorm.rimecleaver.legendary: Hits chill enemies, slowing them to a crawl
weapon.steelstorm.scythe.passive: Heals you for 10% of the damage you deal
weapon.steelstorm.skypiercer.legendary: Double damage against enemies in the air
weapon.steelstorm.spear.passive: Sneak + hold Use to throw it
weapon.steelstorm.voidreaver.legendary: Hits tear at the void, pulling nearby enemies toward the target
